name: Beatrix Vogel
original_name: ベアトリクス・ヴォーガル
source: Beatrix is an intelligent, proud woman with a fiery temper. She can be pushy and arrogant at times but underneath it all she is loyal and loving. She has a fondness for singing.
translation: Beatrix is an intelligent, proud woman with a fiery temper. She can be pushy and arrogant at times but underneath it all she is loyal and loving. She has a fondness for singing.
